entries.en: That is close enough, Commander.
Commander. I recently received a lovely note from Septimus. Thank you for speaking with him.
You are too kind, Commander. But I would not expect you to help me out of the kindness of your heart.
If you would speak to him as a fellow soldier, I believe he will listen to you and let the matter be.
Thank you, Commander. That is all I can ask.
Appeal to his sense of honor. Remind him of his position as a general.
If you can convince him to stop spreading lies about me, I would be very grateful.
Now, I must ask you to take your leave. I have many clients waiting to see me.
Could it be I was wrong about you, Commander? Are you certain you will not aid me in this?
I would not dream of letting you go without payment. I do not make a habit of incurring debts.
I also have one more thing to give you, if you are interested.
I offer a gift of words. An affirmation of who you are, and who you will become....
I see you... your uniform fits as though you were born wearing it. You are a soldier through and through. Proud, solitary... alone, but it gives you strength.
I've heard a great many things about you since your arrival here on our Citadel.
That depends on your needs. I offer advice to some, comfort to others.
I apologize, Commander. I make it my business to know when important people arrive on the station. Many of them become clients.
Uh-huh. Interesting. Why'd you wanna meet with the commander?
Yes, I did. I have a certain problem that could use your expertise.
I have a friend. Septimus, a retired turian general. I won't discuss the details, but he wanted me to be more than I could be.
We had a falling out. Now he spends his days in Chora's Den drinking and spreading lies about me.
I'm glad I could help.
Tell me about this problem you're having.
Maybe I can help.
What exactly do you want me to tell him?
I don't make any promises, but I'll see what I can do.
Why should I bother to help your friend?
I can't spend gratitude.
I'd be honored.
What are you offering me?
You wanted to speak with me?
What exactly do you do?
I don't like people spying on me.
No problem.
Let's talk payment.
Very.
What is it?
What do you want?
Who are you?
You checking up on me?
What is it?
Tell me about it.
Okay.
I'll see.
Not interested.
Goodbye, Commander.
Please, Commander. I ask that you return to me only after you have spoken with Septimus.
Hmm. Interesting. Take care, then, Commander. I doubt we shall meet again.
Goodbye, Sha'ira.
I'll see.
Very sure.
Even the elcor diplomat has withdrawn his campaign against me.
I see the sadness behind your eyes. It tells a story that makes me want to weep. Pain and loss. But it drives you, makes you strong.
I see your skin, tough as the scales on any turian. Unyielding. A wall between you and everyone else. But it protects you, makes you strong.
That strength is what kept you alive when everyone around you was dying. You alone survived. You will continue to survive.
It is that strength that people are drawn to. It is why you lead, and others follow, without question. You will need that leadership in the battles to come.
You never hide your strength, either. It serves you well. Terrifies your foes. Few will dare to stand against you.
Of course.
This may be who you are, but it is not who you will become. It only forms the basis for your future greatness.
Thank you. Not everyone appreciates it as you do.
Never underestimate the power of words.
Here, Commander. In light of your efforts with the elcor ambassador, I would like you to have this small trinket.
A small mystery. I have never learned its use or purpose, but I sense it is time for me to pass it on.
And now, I must ask you to leave. I have done everything I can for you.
Remember my words, Commander Shepard. They will give you strength.
You have quite a gift, Sha'ira.
Um, thanks. I guess.
What is it?
Very astute.
That's it?
Thank you.
So long, Commander. I can offer you nothing more at this time.
Fascinating. Now, you wanted to meet with the commander?
Yeah, well, you wanted to speak with the commander.
I have a certain problem that could use your expertise.
But that is not why I asked you here.
These credits will cover your expenses.
Close your eyes and relax, Commander.
Remember these words when doubt descends, Commander.
It was my honor to aid you.
Get to the point.
Glad to help.
Hurry up.
I respect his privacy too much to go into the details. If he wishes to tell you what happened, that is his prerogative.
What happened between you?
What went wrong?
A trinket?
Thank you.
